problem_text:
A logistics manager must select cargo containers to load onto a freight truck. Available containers are:
* Container 1: weight 42 kg, revenue $168
* Container 2: weight 35 kg, revenue $125
* Container 3: weight 38 kg, revenue $165
* Container 4: weight 1 kg, revenue $221
* Container 5: weight 23 kg, revenue $46
* Container 6: weight 22 kg, revenue $153
* Container 7: weight 50 kg, revenue $187
* Container 8: weight 7 kg, revenue $163
* Container 9: weight 37 kg, revenue $86
* Container 10: weight 23 kg, revenue $29
* Container 11: weight 47 kg, revenue $17
* Container 12: weight 42 kg, revenue $215
* Container 13: weight 1 kg, revenue $231
* Container 14: weight 15 kg, revenue $230
* Container 15: weight 37 kg, revenue $248
* Container 16: weight 19 kg, revenue $12
* Container 17: weight 12 kg, revenue $242
* Container 18: weight 35 kg, revenue $44
* Container 19: weight 42 kg, revenue $17
* Container 20: weight 43 kg, revenue $32
* Container 21: weight 6 kg, revenue $75
* Container 22: weight 26 kg, revenue $206

The truck has a maximum weight capacity of 422 kg. Determine which containers to load to maximize total revenue without exceeding this weight limit. Each container is either fully loaded or left behind.
